item.title: From Socialist to Roman Concepts: The Reform of Property Law in a Developing World
item.description: This article examines structural problems in Vietnamese property law arising from the reception of mixed legal transplants during the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. item.title: The Rise of AI Authorities? A Closer Look at Latin America’s Institutional Responses and External Influences
item.description: Artificial intelligence governance in Latin America is emerging through new legislative proposals that increasingly draw on the European Union’s Artificial Intelligence Act. This article asks how Latin American countries are designing artificial intelligence oversight and enforcement mechanisms, and whether they are replicating the European institutional model for supervisory authorities.
